_about: OCR model sets of task ocr-any (ocr_any_task.py). name -> CRNN model dirs under models/ (in voting order: the first 'stage1' models are the cascade's stage 1 when hints exist), env switches of eciocr/prod/eci_ocr.py (all set explicitly, so the provenance is exact), hints mode ('required': the item must carry a hints key; 'none': run without hints even when the item has some; 'optional'), and the gold results at adoption. A new set = one entry here + its model dirs (crnn.onnx + charset.json) committed; sha256_16 = first 16 hex chars of crnn.onnx's sha256 (checked by the task before the first item).

v4a.about: Hindi SIR with 2027 SSR hints (owner plan 2026-11-25 03:49): v4a students (half-width CRNNs distilled from g8, all convs int8) + Hindi label-variant fix (branch hinvar 2bc0673). 5x less CPU than production c11q..c3q.

gold.source: speed study 2026-11-24 (branch speed-students 41f1d10; Modal eci-eval s11h3x0 s9hx0 s4hx0 s3hx0)

j2Ps.about: Hindi SIR without 2027 hints (owner plan 2026-11-25 03:49): job2's best set: s11h3 (= c11g9s) + job2_r1_s9m + job2_r2_s4m + job2_r2_s3m (int8 x0), no-hint rules NOHINT_DIGITS + EPIC_PREFIX + EPIC_FMT, EPIC_PAIR 1 (job2 NOTES 03:10, queue job2_j2Ps). 3.3x less CPU than production.

gold.source: job2 NOTES 2026-11-25 03:10 (real run j2Ps, branch job2 code without hinvar)

j2Psf.about: j2Ps + ECI_EPIC_OLDFMT=1 (ocrv5 2026-11-25): old-format EPICs of other states (Haryana HR/01/01/0000369, 2 letters / 1-3 / 2-3 / 6-7 digits) count as valid, so they are not flagged for the format alone. Same models and other rules as j2Ps. NOT gold-run (the UP gold sets have no such EPICs); local test: see models2/ocrv5/README.md. For a hot swap of the no-hint states: hub setting ocr_model_set_map {"j2Ps": "j2Psf"}.

gold.note: not gold-run; differs from j2Ps only in the EPIC format check (flags of old-format EPICs)
